name: Sapphire of Aku'Mai
summary: Along Blackfathom Deeps, naga harvest the Sapphires of Aku'Mai. Water spirits cling to the crystals, and Je'neu Sancrea seeks help to seize them before their arcane power is used.

sections.title: Gems of the Deep
sections.body: At the watery entrances to Blackfathom Deeps, the walls along Ashenvale's Zoram Strand bear Sapphires of Aku'Mai. Water spirits cling to the crystals, whose elemental energy lends power to magic. When scouts reported naga quarrying the gems underground, Je'neu Sancrea, a shaman, sought travelers' help to seize them. In naga hands, the stones could fuel devastating arcane rites.

faq.q: What is a Sapphire of Aku'Mai?
faq.answer: Sapphires of Aku'Mai line the walls of Blackfathom Deeps. Water spirits cling to the crystals, giving them deep arcane and elemental power.

faq.q: Why are the naga collecting these sapphires?
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea suspects the naga mean to harness the crystals' water and arcane energies for dangerous sorcery in the submerged temple. Their exact intentions remain uncertain.

faq.q: Who is looking for these sapphires?
aliases: who turns in essence of akumai
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea, an Earthen Ring shaman at Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's Zoram Strand, asks travelers to gather the sapphires and keep them from naga hands.

faq.q: Are these crystals directly tied to the beast Aku'mai?
faq.answer: The crystals take their name from Aku'mai, the monstrous hydra in the deeps, but grow naturally in the cavern walls. Their name reflects their nearness to the dark presence in the ruins.

angles.text: As an Earthen Ring shaman, you can sense the water spirits bound within these gems. The naga harvest threatens the elements.
Water saturates the sapphires naturally, making them valued conduits for potent arcane components.
